text: The third tale begins decades after Minax fell and her evil world was undone.
With evil vanquished, the orc hordes vanished without a trace, and gentle peace once more flowed across the realm.
One day, an adventurer keeping watch over the realm brought back a strange inscribed tablet from Minax's ruins.
Wise priests and monks of Yew studied it, finding that Mondain and Minax had used it in dark rituals to awaken something.
Yet whether that thing was mortal, object, or demon, not even the greatest priest could ever determine.
Decades more passed after that.
Slowly, ominous events began plaguing the once-peaceful kingdom.
It began when a red comet appeared in the sky beside the twin moons Trammel and Felucca.
That ill-omened star shattered, raining fragments upon the earth.
Shards gouged the land as eerie rumbles echoed below. Endless quakes shook Sosaria, and orc hordes once again threatened travelers.
Folk fled to towns guarded by thick walls and moats.
Sea lanes closed as fierce sea beasts and pirates appeared. Evil had returned!
Amid quakes and rumbles, an eerie island rose from the sea in torrents of lava.
Some claimed to see a castle within the steam, though not a single soul believed them.
Yet sensing a dark presence upon that isle, the wise ruler Lord British ordered an expedition.
None of the party ever returned, save for a single survivor...
Gravely wounded, that lone explorer repeated in delirium:
From the depths of hell... Vengeance!... It awakens... No! Hurry... Must stop it... Quickly... To the castle of lava!
Facing this new peril to his realm, Lord British resolved once more to summon heroes.
Yet the quest laid before these heroes is perilous.
Monsters roam the land unchecked, and countless dungeons wait to swallow them whole.
Worse still, the foe's true nature is unknown.
The sole remaining clue is...
A single word scrawled in blood upon the deck of a ship whose crew vanished as if taken by demons... "EXODUS".
